message:
Fix JSON Schema generation for `z.iso.time` with minute precision (#5557)

* Fix JSON Schema generation for z.iso.time with minute precision

When z.iso.time({ precision: -1 }) is used, Zod validates HH:MM format
but toJSONSchema() was generating format: "time" which requires HH:MM:SS
per RFC 3339. This caused validation mismatches where payloads passed
Zod validation but failed JSON Schema validators.

The fix removes format: "time" when precision is -1, relying only on
the pattern regex which correctly validates the HH:MM format. Schemas
with precision >= 0 still include format: "time" as they comply with
RFC 3339.

Added tests covering precision values: -1 (minute), 0 (second), and 3
(millisecond) to ensure correct JSON Schema generation for each case.

Fixes #5542

* Never use format=time for z.iso.time in JSON Schema

JSON Schema format: "time" requires a full time with offset or Z.
z.iso.time() does not include timezone information, so this format
should never be used regardless of precision settings.
